question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Magnanimous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Degraded**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Magnanimous"** means generous or forgiving, especially toward a rival or someone less powerful. (उदार, महान)

 
 
• **Example:** The magnanimous leader forgave his opponents and sought peace for the nation.
 
 
 
• **"Degraded"** refers to something that has been reduced in quality, value, or moral standing; it conveys the opposite of being noble or generous. (गिरा हुआ, पतित)
 
 
• **Example:** The degraded state of the building was a clear sign of years of neglect.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the antonym of **"Magnanimous"** is **"Degraded."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Degraded**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Splendour** (शानदार): Magnificent and splendid appearance or grandeur.

 
 
• **Example:** The palace was a true representation of royal splendour.
 
 
 
• **Large** (बड़ा): Something of considerable size, extent, or capacity.
 
 
• **Example:** The large mansion had over twenty rooms.
 
 
 
• **Generous** (उदार): Showing a readiness to give more of something, such as money or time, than is strictly necessary or expected.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a generous donation to the charity.
